committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 23 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend eased to A$146.19 over the last 7 days from A$163.27 prior, clicks slipped to 24 from 26, and CPC sits at A$6.09 with conversions still at zero. Post-restart clicks since 8 Sept are 53 of the 150 stop-loss threshold.
Rank lost share (73.1%) still dwarfs budget lost share (21.7%), and impression share sits at just 10%. CTR did improve to 4.1% from 3.5% over the same week.
/ai-automation-agency.html pulled 21 of 53 sessions last 7 days, second only to the homepage's 26. Calculator use ticked up to 1 from 0, still too thin to read as a trend.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 2 from 0 last 7 days, all from chatgpt.com, though this channel undercounts since many AI referrals land as Direct with no referrer. LinkedIn stayed at 0 despite Chris's posting, so tagging is worth checking. Organic Search edged up to 10 from 8, still the only unpaid signal worth trusting.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
The homepage form confirm-then-count fix is still open: kontrolTrackLead should fire on the Formspree verdict, not before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week and needs updating to match current site stats.
